description: This file contains implementation of functions related to filesystem stat data manipulation, including copying stat information, comparing it, and checking its validity. It appears to be part of a larger source code involving filesystem metadata handling within a version control or filesystem monitoring context.

methods.name: unsigned int munge_st_size(off_t st_size)
methods.description: Converts a file size of type off_t into an unsigned int, with special handling for files exactly multiple of 4 GiB to avoid misclassification.

methods.name: void fill_stat_data(struct stat_data * sd,struct stat * st)
methods.description: Populates a custom stat_data structure with information from a standard stat struct.

methods.name: void set_times(struct stat * st,const struct stat_data * sd)
methods.description: Sets the access and modification times in a stat struct from a stat_data structure.

methods.name: void fake_lstat_data(const struct stat_data * sd,struct stat * st)
methods.description: Fills a stat struct with data from a stat_data structure, simulating a stat call.

methods.name: int match_stat_data(const struct stat_data * sd,struct stat * st)
methods.description: Compares a stat_data structure with a stat struct to determine if there have been changes.

methods.name: void stat_validity_clear(struct stat_validity * sv)
methods.description: Clears the stored stat_data within a stat_validity structure.

methods.name: int stat_validity_check(struct stat_validity * sv,const char * path)
methods.description: Checks if the current filesystem stat matches the stored stat_data, indicating if the file has changed.

methods.name: void stat_validity_update(struct stat_validity * sv,int fd)
methods.description: Updates the stored stat_data with current filesystem stat information for a given file descriptor.

ctags.name: set_times
ctags.pattern: /^static void set_times(struct stat *st, const struct stat_data *sd)$/
